/* АРХИУМ v3.40 — field mission journal */
.ops-q-head{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:15px 17px;border:1px solid #81713e;background:linear-gradient(110deg,#223022,#101911 76%);margin:12px 0 8px}

.ops-q-gametabs button.sel,.ops-q-statusbuttons button.sel{color:#111c11;background:#e0ba5c}.ops-q-filters>input{flex:1 1 175px;min-width:0}.ops-q-filters>select{background:#101d16;border:1px solid #72613a;color:#e6ce87;padding:10px;font:inherit;font-size:11px;max-width:185px}
.ops-q-view{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(180px,36%) minmax(0,1fr);height:min(590px,67vh);min-height:350px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #88703b;background:#07120d;gap:0}
.ops-q-list{overflow-y:auto;border-right:1px solid #79633c;padding:5px;background:#0c1911;scrollbar-color:#ab914f #0d1b12}
.ops-q-listitem{cursor:pointer;width:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:11px 8px;margin:0 0 4px;background:#17241a;color:#dfd2ab;border:1px solid transparent;text-align:left;font:inherit;min-height:60px}
.ops-q-listitem:hover{background:#233522;border-color:#685934}.ops-q-listitem.selected{background:linear-gradient(90deg,#4a4928,#202c1d);border-color:#c3a754;box-shadow:inset 4px 0 #e6c067}
.ops-q-index{flex-shrink:0;color:#b1a16c;font-size:10px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ops-q-listtxt{min-width:0;flex:1}.ops-q-listtxt b{font-size:12px;line-height:1.25;display:block;color:#f0d58a}.ops-q-listtxt small{font-size:10px;color:#a4bda0;display:block;margin-top:6px}.ops-q-state{display:grid;place-items:center;width:19px;height:19px;color:#a2a68f;border:1px solid #55644d;flex-shrink:0;font-weight:900}.ops-q-state.done{color:#8aeda2;border-color:#4e9a63}.ops-q-state.active{color:#efc967;border-color:#998443}
.ops-q-details{overflow:auto;padding:21px 24px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 10%,#253323,#0b1710 73%);scrollbar-color:#ab914f #0d1b12}
.ops-q-detail-header{border-bottom:1px solid #7a693c;padding-bottom:11px}.ops-q-id{color:#bea85f;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2px}.ops-q-detail-header h3{font-size:clamp(19px,3.5vw,30px);margin:9px 0!important}.ops-q-detail-header p{color:#b0c0a9;font-size:12px}.ops-q-status{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.7px;padding:4px 6px;border:1px solid #726b42;color:#c2b77c}.ops-q-status.done{color:#a8e3ac;border-color:#478758}.ops-q-status.active{color:#e9c46d;border-color:#b39044}.ops-q-desc{border-left:3px solid #9c8d48;background:#1a2a1d;padding:14px;margin:16px 0;font-size:13px;color:#dbdcc4;line-height:1.65}.ops-q-details h4{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px;margin:15px 0 8px;color:#f3c85f}
.ops-q-steps{margin:8px 0 15px;padding-left:24px}.ops-q-steps li{padding:5px 0;font-size:12px;color:#c1d2c1;line-height:1.55}.ops-q-statusbuttons{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px}.ops-q-links{margin-top:16px;padding:10px;background:#111f16;border:1px solid #435740}.ops-q-links button{background:#1c2a1d;border:1px solid #776536;color:#e4c76a;padding:7px 10px;margin:0 5px 6px 0;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}.ops-q-links button:hover{border-color:#e7c86c}.ops-q-source{margin-top:13px;padding:10px 2px;border-top:1px dashed #696743;font-size:10px;color:#8baf8a}.ops-q-source b{display:block;letter-spacing:1px}.ops-q-source a{display:block;color:#e8ca80;padding-top:6px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.ops-q-empty{padding:24px;color:#c2b88b}.ops-q-legend{padding:10px 13px;margin:13px 0;border-left:3px solid #78987d;color:#aebea8;font-size:11px;background:#142119}
.ops-q-shield{padding:22px;border:1px dashed #bd9c4a;margin:20px 0;background:#2c2719;text-align:center}.ops-q-shield b{display:block;color:#ffd785;letter-spacing:1px}.ops-q-shield button{background:#b18a41;border:0;color:#10190e;font-weight:bold;padding:9px;cursor:pointer}

@media(max-width:700px){.ops-q-view{grid-template-columns:1fr;height:auto;min-height:0;overflow:visible}.ops-q-list{max-height:290px;overflow-y:auto;border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid #79633c}.ops-q-details{max-height:none;overflow:visible;min-height:280px;padding:15px}.ops-q-filters>select{flex:1 1 100px}.ops-q-filters>input{flex-basis:100%}.ops-q-head{padding:10px}.ops-q-metrics b{font-size:19px}.ops-q-metrics{margin-top:7px}.ops-q-listitem{min-height:52px}.ops-q-statusbuttons button{padding:8px}}

/* v6.18: public YooMoney support link */
.support-donate-link{display:inline-flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;align-self:stretch;gap:8px;min-height:52px;margin-top:16px;padding:14px 17px;border:1px solid #e5bf6a;border-radius:8px;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#f0cd7e,#b99043);box-shadow:0 7px 20px #0008,inset 0 1px #ffefbc77;color:#18170e!important;font-weight:900;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.45px;text-decoration:none!important;transition:transform .18s,filter .18s,box-shadow .18s;cursor:pointer}

/* v6.36 original screenshots, genuine game labels and offline-safe fallback */
.archium-game-shot{background:linear-gradient(160deg,#13231a,#080e0a);border:1px solid #70623d;border-left:3px solid #bfa34e;padding:10px;margin:10px 0 14px;min-width:0;}
.archium-game-shot-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:9px;color:#ecca75;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.1px;}
.archium-game-shot-head span{border:1px solid #685a33;padding:3px 8px;color:#e6ca90;}
.archium-game-shot-frame{width:100%;min-height:90px;overflow:hidden;background:#080e0b;display:grid;place-items:center;}
.archium-game-shot-img{display:block;max-height:265px;width:100%;object-fit:contain;background:#070c09;}
.archium-game-shot-empty{padding:12px 9px;color:#a9b6a0;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;}
.archium-game-shot-credit{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 11px;align-items:center;padding:9px 0;font-size:11px;color:#c8ccb6;line-height:1.45;}
.archium-game-shot-credit a{color:#e5c478;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:2px;}
.archium-game-shot-credit small{color:#a5ab97;font-size:10px;}
.archium-game-shot-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.archium-shot-upload,.archium-shot-clear{border:1px solid #877443;background:#1b271d;color:#f1d58d;padding:8px 11px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;min-height:34px;position:relative;}
.archium-shot-upload input{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;opacity:0;cursor:pointer;}
.archium-shot-upload.busy{opacity:.6;pointer-events:none;}
.archium-shot-clear{background:#211b13;color:#d7b69b;}
.archium-hero-photo-label{position:absolute;top:8px;left:8px;z-index:5;max-width:calc(100% - 16px);font-size:9px;color:#f7deb0;background:#050907e8;padding:6px 9px;border:1px solid #8e7847;letter-spacing:.6px;pointer-events:none;}
.archium-game-row-note{color:#afb9a4;font-size:11px;}

/* v6.37: photographic archive audit, backup/restore, per-game coverage */

.archium-photo-status:not(:disabled):hover{background:#53623b;color:#fff1be;}
@media(max-width:710px){.archium-gallery-audit{padding:10px}.archium-gallery-audit p{font-size:10px}.archium-gallery-actions button,.archium-gallery-actions label{min-height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:1 1 130px}.archium-photo-status{flex-basis:76px;font-size:9px;min-height:38px;padding:5px 2px;}}

/* АРХИУМ v3.40: unified Zone map / wholly self-contained, no network requests */
.map-panel.gm-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 280px;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr);min-height:0;gap:0;background:#09150f}

.gm-toolbar-head{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;color:#f2d687;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1.2px;white-space:nowrap}.gm-toolbar-head small{font-size:8px;color:#9fba9e;letter-spacing:.8px}
.gm-chips{display:flex;gap:5px;flex-wrap:wrap}.gm-chips label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 7px;border:1px solid #4b6149;background:#0b170f;white-space:nowrap;color:#ccdabd;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;user-select:none}.gm-chips label:has(input:checked){background:#3b361e;border-color:#ac914d;color:#ffe4a7}.gm-chips input{width:12px;height:12px;margin:0;accent-color:#e6be5d}
.gm-counter{font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-size:9px;color:#e4be65;white-space:nowrap}
.map-panel.gm-wrap .map-area{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;min-height:0;background:#101a14;position:relative;overflow:hidden;touch-action:none}
.map-panel.gm-wrap .map-area:before{pointer-events:none;z-index:2;opacity:.24}
.map-panel.gm-wrap .map-side{grid-column:2;grid-row:2;width:auto;min-width:0;height:auto;overflow:auto;padding:14px 15px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#101f17,#09120f);border-left:1px solid #746338;scrollbar-color:#64582f #0e1912}
.map-canvas.gm-board{overflow:visible;transform-origin:center center;will-change:transform;transition:transform .06s linear;isolation:isolate}
.gm-terrain{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:url('data:image/webp;base64,');background-position:center;background-size:100% 100%;filter:saturate(.84) contrast(1.15);pointer-events:none}
.gm-coordinate-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(#e0c67610 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,#e0c67610 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(#e0c67617 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,#e0c67617 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:5% 5%,5% 5%,25% 25%,25% 25%;pointer-events:none;mix-blend-mode:screen}
.gm-north,.gm-south{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;font-family:Consolas,monospace;font-weight:bold;color:#d8bb71aa;text-shadow:0 2px 8px #000;letter-spacing:1px}.gm-north{right:2%;top:4%;font-size:12px}.gm-south{bottom:2%;left:37%;font-size:10px}
.gm-paths{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none;opacity:1}
.gm-node{z-index:2;position:absolute;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);border:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;min-width:0;max-width:125px;padding:1px;color:#ecd08a;cursor:pointer;white-space:normal}
.gm-node:before{display:none}.gm-dot{width:10px;height:10px;border:2px solid #f3d379;background:#172719;box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #0b160de0,0 0 13px #efcf7752;transform:rotate(45deg);flex:none}
.gm-node-label{margin-top:5px;background:#07110be8;border:1px solid #8c7745;color:#f4e0ab;padding:4px 5px;font-size:10px;font-family:Arial,sans-serif;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;font-weight:800;box-shadow:0 2px 8px #000a;white-space:normal;text-wrap:balance}
.gm-node.gm-lab .gm-dot{border-color:#8bbdd6;border-radius:2px}.gm-node.gm-lab .gm-node-label{border-color:#5d8798;color:#cae1eb;font-size:9px;background:#0e2029e9}
.gm-node:hover,.gm-node.gm-selected{background:transparent;box-shadow:none;z-index:5}.gm-node:hover .gm-node-label,.gm-node.gm-selected .gm-node-label{background:#af8d3c;color:#0a140d;border-color:#ffe49c;box-shadow:0 0 14px #dfad4e88}
.gm-node.gm-selected .gm-dot{animation:gm-pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite;background:#f8de86}
.gm-poi,.gm-userpin{position:absolute;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);z-index:4;width:19px;height:19px;border:1px solid #a5bd7e;border-radius:50%;background:#09180feb;color:#e5c47a;font-size:13px;line-height:15px;padding:0;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #08110ad1}.gm-poi.anomaly{border-color:#81b4df;color:#9acee8}.gm-userpin{color:#f4d384;border-color:#f2be61;font-size:11px}.gm-poi:hover,.gm-userpin:hover{filter:brightness(1.45);z-index:9}
.gm-floating{position:absolute;z-index:6;right:10px;bottom:10px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px}.gm-floating button{width:33px;height:33px;cursor:pointer;background:#08150edc;border:1px solid #ae904d;color:#f4d77d;font-size:18px;box-shadow:0 0 14px #000a}.gm-floating button:hover{background:#55461f}
.gm-side h3{color:#f0cd70;font-size:18px;line-height:1.15;margin:8px 0}.gm-side p{color:#becbb7;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55;margin:12px 0}
.gm-side-meta{font-size:9px;color:#aabd94;letter-spacing:1.5px;font-family:Consolas,monospace}.gm-games{display:flex;gap:5px;margin:8px 0 12px}.gm-tag{border:1px solid #8d824d;padding:3px 6px;background:#172319;color:#f2d38b;font-size:10px}.gm-cs{border-color:#668899;color:#a8d9e2}.gm-cop{border-color:#748c5d;color:#bddb9e}
.gm-callout{border:1px solid #3c5d4d;border-left:3px solid #bb9855;background:#15251b;padding:9px;display:grid;gap:4px;color:#aebfae;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}.gm-callout b{color:#e5c678;font-size:10px}.gm-side-sub{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#e2c479;font-weight:bold;border-bottom:1px solid #43553a;padding:14px 0 6px;margin-bottom:6px}
.gm-neighbors{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;max-height:140px;overflow:auto}.gm-neighbors button{border:1px solid #506046;background:#142217;color:#bdcbb6;padding:6px;font-size:10px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left}.gm-neighbors button:hover{border-color:#e1bd67;color:#ffe6ab}
.gm-primary,.gm-secondary-actions button{cursor:pointer;background:#b9974e;color:#10190f;border:1px solid #efc977;padding:9px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.4px;margin-top:12px}.gm-primary:disabled{background:#263127;color:#8b9d87;cursor:default;border-color:#43513e}.gm-secondary-actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}.gm-secondary-actions button{background:#122219;color:#e5ca78;border-color:#6b744d;margin-top:8px;flex:1;min-width:85px;padding:7px;font-size:9px}.gm-secondary-actions button.gm-active{background:#625127;color:#fff1b6}
.gm-markerform{padding:11px;border:1px solid #b89456;background:#1b251a;margin-bottom:12px}.gm-markerform label{display:block;color:#dabe75;font-size:10px;margin:5px 0 9px}.gm-markerform input,.gm-markerform textarea{width:100%;resize:vertical;min-width:0;display:block;background:#08140f;color:#e6dfc3;border:1px solid #6d704c;padding:7px;margin:5px 0}.gm-markerform div{display:flex;gap:5px}.gm-markerform button{cursor:pointer;border:1px solid #a68a48;background:#273122;color:#ead68c;padding:8px;font-size:10px}.gm-markerform .gm-primary{margin:0;background:#ae8d42;color:#0a120b}
.gm-citation{font-size:9px;line-height:1.55;color:#8aa190;margin-top:15px;border-top:1px solid #485239;padding-top:9px}.gm-citation b{display:block;margin-bottom:5px;color:#baa66f}.gm-citation a{display:block;color:#b9d0ad;text-decoration:underline;padding:2px 0}
@keyframes gm-pulse{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #0b160de0,0 0 12px #cf9a4577}50%{box-shadow:0 0 0 7px #a6883544,0 0 24px #f7cc7899}}
#device.no-effects .gm-selected .gm-dot{animation:none!important}
@media(max-width:900px){.map-panel.gm-wrap{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 230px}.gm-toolbar{gap:5px;padding:5px 7px}.gm-chips label{padding:4px 5px;font-size:9px}.gm-toolbar-head small{display:none}.gm-node-label{font-size:9px;max-width:90px}}
@media(max-width:710px){.map-panel.gm-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(160px,1fr) minmax(140px,33%)}.gm-toolbar{grid-column:1;grid-row:1;gap:5px}.gm-toolbar-head{font-size:10px}.gm-chips{gap:3px}.gm-chips label{padding:4px}.gm-chips label span{font-size:9px}.gm-counter{font-size:8px}.map-panel.gm-wrap .map-area{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;min-height:155px}.map-panel.gm-wrap .map-side{grid-column:1;grid-row:3;min-height:140px;height:auto;overflow:auto;padding:9px 12px;border-top:1px solid #80703f;border-left:0}.gm-node .gm-node-label{font-size:8px;padding:2px 3px;max-width:78px}.gm-node .gm-dot{height:7px;width:7px;border-width:1px}.gm-node.gm-lab .gm-node-label{font-size:8px}.gm-side h3{font-size:16px}.gm-side p{font-size:11px;margin:6px 0}.gm-side-sub{padding:6px 0 4px}.gm-citation{margin-top:8px}.gm-callout{padding:6px}.gm-floating{bottom:4px;right:4px}.gm-floating button{width:30px;height:28px}}

 backdrop-filter:blur(8px);animation:archiumWelcomeIn .28s ease-out both}

<style id="archium-main629-styles">
/* MAIN v6.29: noninteractive and low-cost signal effect across the full PDA */
#archium-signal-glitch{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:101700;pointer-events:none;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;overflow:hidden;contain:strict;transform:translateZ(0);background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 7px,rgba(143,236,169,.06) 8px,transparent 9px 13px);}
#archium-signal-glitch::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 24%,rgba(149,211,178,.10) 26%,transparent 28% 48%,rgba(240,197,110,.07) 50%,transparent 52% 75%,rgba(149,211,178,.09) 76%,transparent 78%);opacity:.55;}
#archium-signal-glitch::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(162,235,167,.06) 0 1px,transparent 1px 5px);transform:translateX(0);}
#archium-signal-glitch.is-active{visibility:visible;animation:archium-glitch-flicker 480ms steps(1,end) both}
#archium-signal-glitch.is-active::after{animation:archium-glitch-shear 480ms steps(1,end) both}
#archium-signal-glitch.level-soft{--signal-alpha:.16}
#archium-signal-glitch.level-medium{--signal-alpha:.28}
@keyframes archium-glitch-flicker{0%,100%{opacity:0}12%{opacity:var(--signal-alpha,.16)}24%{opacity:.025}39%{opacity:var(--signal-alpha,.16)}48%{opacity:0}67%{opacity:.10}79%{opacity:0}}
@keyframes archium-glitch-shear{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0)}20%{transform:translateX(4px)}41%{transform:translateX(-3px)}61%{transform:translateX(2px)}83%{transform:translateX(0)}}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){#archium-signal-glitch,#archium-signal-glitch.is-active,#archium-signal-glitch::after{animation:none!important;visibility:hidden!important;opacity:0!important}}
/* Settings cards inherit native terminal palette and fit 320px phones. */
.archium11-panel{margin:18px 0 15px;padding:15px;border:1px solid #657a59;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#192a20,#0b1710);border-radius:8px;box-shadow:0 6px 22px #0004;color:#e7e3c9;max-width:100%;}
.archium11-panel *{box-sizing:border-box}
.archium11-heading{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin:0 0 8px;font-size:14px;letter-spacing:1px;color:#eace7d;font-weight:850}
.archium11-chip{display:inline-block;border:1px solid #bdac69;border-radius:3px;padding:4px 7px;font:800 9px/1.2 Consolas,monospace;color:#f6dc9c;background:#38321b}
.archium11-description{margin:4px 0 13px;color:#b8c4ac;font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
